52pojie 悬赏问答区是金矿——**394,398 个主题，今日 103 个**。抓实际悬赏帖列表。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
 "const u='https://www.52pojie.cn/forum-8-1.html';",
 "const pu=new URL(u);",
 "http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept-Language':'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){",
 " let b=Buffer.concat(c);",
 " let s;",
 " try{ s=new TextDecoder('gbk').decode(b); }catch(e){ s=b.toString('utf8'); }",
 " // 提取帖子标题与链接",
 " const re=/<a href=\"(thread-[0-9]+-1-1\\.html)\"[^>]*class=\"s xst\"[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/a>/g;",
 " let m, rows=[];",
 " while((m=re.exec(s))!==null){ rows.push({url:m[1], title:m[2].replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').trim()}); }",
 " console.log('THREADS FOUND:', rows.length);",
 " for(const r of rows.slice(0,40)){ console.log('- '+r.title); }",
 " // 也提取悬赏值",
 " const re2=/(悬赏[^0-9]{0,6}(\\d+)[^0-9]{0,4}(CB|cb|论坛币|吾爱币))/g;",
 " const t=s.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
 " const m2=[...t.matchAll(re2)].map(x=>x[0]).slice(0,15);",
 " console.log('\\n悬赏值样例:', JSON.stringify(m2));",
 " });",
 "});",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-re2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-re2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch 52pojie bounty thread list", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 7000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
  "const u='https://www.52pojie.cn/forum-8-1.html';",
  "const pu=new URL(u);",
  "http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept-Language':'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9'}},function(res){",
  "  const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "  res.on('end',function(){",
  "    let b=Buffer.concat(c);",
  "    let s;",
  "    try{ s=new TextDecoder('gbk').decode(b); }catch(e){ s=b.toString('utf8'); }",
  "    // 提取帖子标题与链接",
  "    const re=/<a href=\"(thread-[0-9]+-1-1\\.html)\"[^>]*class=\"s xst\"[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/a>/g;",
  "    let m, rows=[];",
  "    while((m=re.exec(s))!==null){ rows.push({url:m[1], title:m[2].replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').trim()}); }",
  "    console.log('THREADS FOUND:', rows.length);",
  "    for(const r of rows.slice(0,40)){ console.log('- '+r.title); }",
  "    // 也提取悬赏值",
  "    const re2=/(悬赏[^0-9]{0,6}(\\d+)[^0-9]{0,4}(CB|cb|论坛币|吾爱币))/g;",
  "    const t=s.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
  "    const m2=[...t.matchAll(re2)].map(x=>x[0]).slice(0,15);",
  "    console.log('\\n悬赏值样例:', JSON.stringify(m2));",
  "  });",
  "});",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-re2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-re2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch 52pojie bounty thread list", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 7000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
